SETUP FIREBASE.

This app is intended to ship with a Firebase config hard-coded. To configure it, follow these steps and paste your config into the HTML.

1

Create a Firebase project

Go to console.firebase.google.com, click Add project.

2

Enable Authentication

Build → Authentication → Get started. Enable Email/Password, Google, and Anonymous.

3

Create Firestore

Build → Firestore Database → Create. Paste these rules under the Rules tab:

rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /users/{userId} { allow read: if request.auth != null; allow create, update: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.uid == userId || request.auth.uid == '9DURgNdTyUhtBso2L8Lo22R3Dru1'); } match /usernames/{name} { allow read: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid; allow delete: if request.auth != null && resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid; } match /queue/{userId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create, update: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId; // Allow deleting any queue entry (matchmaking transactions need this) allow delete: if request.auth != null; } match /matches/{matchId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null; allow update, delete: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.caller == request.auth.uid || resource.data.callee == request.auth.uid); match /callerCandidates/{doc} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; } match /calleeCandidates/{doc} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; } } match /friendRequests/{reqId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.from == request.auth.uid; allow update, delete: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.from == request.auth.uid || resource.data.to == request.auth.uid); } match /invites/{inviteId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.from == request.auth.uid; allow update, delete: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.from == request.auth.uid || resource.data.to == request.auth.uid); } match /activity/{actId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid; } match /matchHistory/{histId} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid; } match /reports/{reportId} { allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.reporter == request.auth.uid; // Only the admin can read / triage / dismiss (delete) reports. allow read, list, update, delete: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == '9DURgNdTyUhtBso2L8Lo22R3Dru1'; } match /profileComments/{profileUid}/comments/{id} { allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.from == request.auth.uid; allow delete: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.from == request.auth.uid || profileUid == request.auth.uid || request.auth.uid == '9DURgNdTyUhtBso2L8Lo22R3Dru1'); } match /globalChat/{msgId} { // Anyone signed in can read the room. You may only post AS yourself, with a // short non-empty message. No edits. Delete your own message — or admin deletes any. allow read, list: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid && request.resource.data.text is string && request.resource.data.text.size() > 0 && request.resource.data.text.size() <= 300; allow delete: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid || request.auth.uid == '9DURgNdTyUhtBso2L8Lo22R3Dru1'); } } }
4

Add your domain

Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains. Add your GitHub Pages domain (e.g. yourname.github.io).

5

Paste config into the HTML

Project settings → Your apps → </> → register, then copy the firebaseConfig object. Open rosham.html, find the FIREBASE_CONFIG constant near the top of the <script> section, and replace the placeholder object with your real config.

// Find this near the top of the <script type="module"> section: const FIREBASE_CONFIG = { apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY", authDomain: "YOUR_PROJECT.firebaseapp.com", projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT", appId: "1:..." };

WHAT IS ROSHCAM

Rock, paper, scissors — face to face with the world.

ROSHCAM is real-time webcam rock·paper·scissors against actual strangers. Your camera reads your hand, you read their eyes, and you both throw on the count of three. Win rounds, climb the ranked ladder, and level up — no download, right in your browser.

Free · no download · works in any browser
VS
HOW IT WORKS

Four steps to your first win

1
Turn on your camera
We detect your hand gesture live, on your device — no clicks, just throw.
2
Meet a stranger
Get matched face-to-face with a real player somewhere in the world.
3
Throw on three
Rock, paper or scissors — hold it steady as the countdown hits zero.
4
Win & climb
Take the match, gain ELO, and rise from Bronze all the way to Legend.
UNDER THE HOOD

How it's built

Live hand detection
In-browser computer vision reads your gesture in real time — the camera is the controller.
Peer-to-peer video
WebRTC connects you straight to your opponent for low-latency, face-to-face duels.
Ranked ELO ladder
Every match shifts your rating. Nine tiers, seasonal resets, real stakes.
Levels & prestige
Earn XP, unlock titles, and prestige all the way to Prestige Master.

TERMS OF SERVICE

Last updated: 31 May 2026

Welcome to ROSHCAM ("the Service"), a real-time webcam rock-paper-scissors game. By creating an account or playing, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

1. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old to use ROSHCAM. The Service streams live camera to strangers and is strictly for adults — there is no parental-consent exception. We verify your date of birth at entry and may suspend any account we believe belongs to a minor. Do not use the Service if you cannot legally consent to camera-based features.

2. Your account

You are responsible for your account, your username, and all activity that happens under it. Keep your login secure. Choose a username that is not offensive, impersonating, or infringing — we may reclaim or reset usernames that violate these Terms.

3. Camera & live video

ROSHCAM matches you with other real people over a live, peer-to-peer video connection so you can play face-to-face. By playing you understand that:

  • Your camera and microphone feed are streamed directly to your opponent during a match.
  • You are visible and audible to a stranger. Do not show anything you wouldn't want a stranger to see — including other people, minors, private documents, or your exact location.
  • Other users could potentially record or screenshot the session using external tools outside our control. Treat every match as public.
  • You must be fully and appropriately clothed and must not show nudity, sexual content, violence, or anything illegal.

4. Conduct & fair play

You agree not to: harass, threaten, or abuse other players; transmit hateful, sexual, violent, or illegal content; cheat, exploit bugs, script, or manipulate ratings/XP; impersonate others; or attempt to de-anonymize, stalk, or contact players off-platform without consent. Ranked results, ELO, and XP are provided for fun and may be adjusted, reset, or corrected at any time.

5. Reporting & moderation

You can report and block other players in-app. We may review reports and may warn, suspend, or permanently ban accounts that violate these Terms, at our discretion. We may end any match and remove any content.

6. Friend challenges

Private friend challenges are casual and do not affect ELO, XP, or challenge progress. Ranked matches against random opponents do affect your rating.

7. Availability & "as is"

ROSHCAM is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service, that matches will always connect, or that ratings/data will never be lost. Features may change or be removed.

8. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, ROSHCAM and its operators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for the conduct of other users, content shown over video, or anything you encounter while using the Service. Your sole remedy is to stop using the Service.

9. Termination

You may stop using ROSHCAM at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access if you breach these Terms or to protect other users or the Service.

10. Changes

We may update these Terms. Material changes will be reflected by the "last updated" date. Continued use after changes means you accept them.

Questions? Contact us at support@roshcam.com.

PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: 31 May 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what ROSHCAM collects, how your camera works, and what we do (and don't do) with your data. We've tried to write it in plain language.

The short version

  • Your video is peer-to-peer. During a match, your camera and mic stream directly to your opponent's device. We do not record, store, or watch your video or audio on our servers.
  • Hand-gesture detection runs locally in your browser — your camera frames are processed on your own device, not uploaded.
  • We store the minimum account data needed to run the game (see below).
  • We never sell your personal data.

1. Camera & microphone

When you play, your browser requests camera/mic access. The live feed is sent over an encrypted peer-to-peer (WebRTC) connection straight to the person you're matched with, so you can play face-to-face. Our servers help the two of you connect but are not in the path of the video itself, and we do not record it. Gesture recognition (detecting rock/paper/scissors) happens on your device using an in-browser model; those camera frames never leave your computer.

You can revoke camera access any time in your browser settings — but you won't be able to play without it.

2. What we store

To run accounts, matchmaking, and leaderboards we store: your email (for login), username, country, optional bio/status, optional profile photo, avatar colour, and game data such as rating (ELO), wins/losses/draws, XP/level, streaks, match history, friends, blocked users, and reports you file.

3. How we use it

We use this data only to: provide the game and matchmaking, show profiles/leaderboards/activity, run friends and messaging, enforce our Terms (moderation, bans), and keep the Service working. We do not use it for advertising and we do not sell it.

4. Messages, profiles & comments

Direct messages and profile comments you post are stored so they can be delivered and displayed. Anything you put on your public profile (username, status, bio, photo, comments) is visible to other signed-in players. Use Streamer mode in Settings to blur usernames on your screen while streaming.

5. Service providers

We use Google Firebase (authentication, database, hosting) to operate the Service. Your account and game data are stored on Firebase infrastructure subject to Google's security practices. Connection setup may use standard STUN/TURN servers to establish the peer-to-peer video link.

6. Local storage on your device

We keep some settings locally in your browser (volume, low-power mode, pinned friends, head-to-head history, daily/weekly challenge progress). You can clear these from Settings → "Clear local data" or your browser.

7. Your choices & rights

You can edit or delete most profile fields in-app, export your data from Settings, block/report players, and stop using the Service at any time. To request deletion of your account and associated data, contact us at the email below. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal data.

8. Children

ROSHCAM is an 18+ adults-only service and is not directed to anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor is using ROSHCAM, report it in-app (Report → "Child safety") or email safety@roshcam.com; suspected child sexual exploitation is reported to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) at report.cybertip.org.

9. Security

We use encryption in transit and reputable infrastructure, but no online service is 100% secure. Because video is peer-to-peer with strangers, please treat every match as public and never reveal sensitive personal information on camera.

10. Changes

We may update this Policy; the "last updated" date will change. Significant changes may also be announced in-app.

Privacy questions or data requests: privacy@roshcam.com.

SAFETY CENTER

ROSHCAM is an 18+ service · last updated 26 Jun 2026
A child is in immediate danger?

Contact your local emergency number right now (US/Canada 911, UK 999, EU 112). Then report it below — don't wait for us.

How to report someone

  • In a match: tap the Report button in the match controls. Pick a reason — "Child safety" is the first option and is reviewed urgently. The player is blocked from matching with you immediately.
  • A snapshot of the other player's camera can be attached automatically as evidence.
  • Anywhere else: open a player's profile to block them, or email us at safety@roshcam.com.

What's banned

These will get an account permanently removed, and serious cases are referred to authorities:

  • Anyone under 18 using ROSHCAM, or any content involving a minor.
  • Nudity, sexual content, or sexual solicitation.
  • Harassment, threats, hate, or abuse.
  • Violence, self-harm content, or anything illegal.
  • Pressuring someone for personal info, money, or to move off-platform.
Child sexual abuse material (CSAM)

Suspected child sexual exploitation can be reported directly to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC), which works with law enforcement worldwide:

  • CyberTipline — report.cybertip.org · phone 1-800-843-5678
  • missingkids.org

Help & hotlines

  • Childhelp (abuse, US) — childhelphotline.org · call/text 1-800-422-4453
  • 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (US) — call or text 988
  • NSPCC (UK) — 0808 800 5000 · nspcc.org.uk
  • Child Helpline International (find a hotline in your country) — childhelplineinternational.org
  • INHOPE (report illegal content, global network) — inhope.org

Tips for staying safe

  • Treat every match as public — anyone could record it.
  • Never share your full name, address, school, workplace, or socials on camera.
  • Your opponent stays hidden until the throw, and you can mute your mic or blur their camera any time from in-match Options.
  • Trust your gut: Leave ends any match instantly, and Report + block stops them re-matching you.
  • Direct messages are limited to people you've both added as friends.

Safety concerns or to report a minor: safety@roshcam.com. We review every report.

HOW TO PLAY

Make a shape with your hand on camera. Both players hold up a hand to ready up — when both are steady, the round auto-starts.

ROCK
closed fist
PAPER
open palm
SCISSORS
2 fingers

Ranks: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond → Master → Grandmaster → Champion → Legend. Each rank has 3 tiers. Win to gain ELO, lose to drop — climbing gets tougher the higher you go.

Forfeit & disconnect rules
  • Leave or refresh mid-match = a forfeit: it counts as a loss and costs an extra −25 ELO.
  • Connection drop? No instant loss — you each get 30 seconds to reconnect. If your opponent doesn't return, you take the win.
  • Switching tabs/apps during a live round starts a 10-second timer (anti-cheat). Come back in time and you're fine.
  • Friend (casual) matches never affect your ELO, W/L or rank.

Camera calibration

ROSHCAM reads your hand from your webcam, so good setup = fewer missed throws. This quick check tunes your framing and lighting. Takes ~20 seconds and makes matches far more reliable.

  • Camera & framing
  • Lighting quality
Looking for you…

Frame yourself

Sit so your head and shoulders fill the frame, camera at roughly eye level. Keep about an arm's length of space so your raised hand fits in view.

Measuring light…
Analyzing your lighting…

Check your lighting

Face a light source — a window or lamp in front of you works best. Avoid bright lights or windows behind you (it turns you into a silhouette).

Calibration complete!

Camera and lighting verified. You're ready to throw hands.
